class.name: SteamSocketEndpoint
class.brief_description: An immutable direct or Steam P2P route for a standalone socket.
class.description: Use [method direct] for numeric IP routes and [method p2p] for a Steam individual account and virtual port. For direct outgoing connections that must reach a specific account, add [method expect_peer]. Direct connections without a pin still require the connected endpoint to have a Steam-certified identity and encrypted transport.

method.name: direct
method.description: Returns a numeric IPv4 or IPv6 route with a physical UDP port from 1 to 65535. Returns [code]null[/code] for invalid input. Wildcard addresses are for listeners.

method.name: p2p
method.description: Returns a route to a canonical decimal SteamID64 for an individual Steam account. Use your own ID for a listener and the remote account for a connection. The virtual port is from 0 to 65535. Returns [code]null[/code] for invalid input.

method.name: expect_peer
method.description: Branches a direct route with a pinned certified individual or game server identity. Returns [code]null[/code] for an invalid account or P2P route. Apply the returned route to [method SteamSockets.connect_to].

method.name: get_address
method.description: Returns the specified address or an empty string for P2P.

method.name: get_port
method.description: Returns the configured physical or virtual port.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Returns the P2P identity or optional direct identity pin.

members.member: The supplied numeric direct address. P2P routes have an empty address.
The physical UDP port for direct routes or logical port for P2P routes.
The canonical P2P identity or optional direct identity pin.

constants.constant: Numeric IP address with a physical UDP port.
Steam individual identity with a virtual port.
